description: This source file defines the code-behind for the MCQExam page of an online examination system. It handles loading multiple-choice questions from a database, managing timer events, and processing user exam submissions, including calculating marks and storing results in a database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page managing exam questions, timer, and submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initial method to load questions from the database into the page and set up the timer.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates exam marks based on user responses, stores results in the database, and redirects to results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles countdown timer events, updates remaining time, and handles time-out scenario.
